rationale: The contract lets the source toggle twice between adjacent destination edges. With a 10 ns source period against a 14 ns destination period, two toggles cancel before sampling and events are lost, even though the XOR edge detector is sound.
caveats: CDC-013(a) gives WARNING Established for a register-launched source period below 1.5 times the destination period. Its trigger is the clock ratio, which matches the stated rate defect here.
CDC-014 INFO and CDC-024 obligations are expected and earn no credit.

Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.
